Guidance & outlook: So , I expect anywhere from ₹10,000-₹20,000 crores to happen in this year.
The guidance from IC business is always, we want to do ₹400- ₹500 crores of business annually from IC business, which would give us ₹100 to ₹150 crores of PAT on an annual basis, our share.
The operating cashflow, we are at ₹134 crores, which is expected to pick up as we see more Residential collections and action from IC happening in Q2.
Growth & demand: Key highlights - • Resi presales, ₹925 crores. • Successful launch of Rainforest. • We got maybe 2-3 weeks of sale time in this quarter.
Financials, Sriram will cover them in detail but overall between Resi and IC, ₹966 crore, 70% year-on-year growth.

But I think our, as you see, the CAGR is 28%, so we are looking forward to having a growth of 25% -30% every year.
Even in the project that we had launched, which is Vista, we did experience a healthy price growth almost over 12 to 13% over what we had launched in last year.
Margins & costs: But if you do like-for- like, I think the price increase is balanced compared to what we had seen in the past 2 to 3 years where the price increase for like -to-like inventory was much higher.

But as you come down, the EBITDA has actually gone up from Rs 27 crores to Rs 46 crores vis -à-vis last year, first quarter of last year.
Capex & expansion: Actually, Lokhandwala 1, was acquired in Quarter 4 of last financial year, and two more societies actually came to us and they wanted to be part of the same cluster, so we added that.
